Updates sysvar accounts and checks instruction account keys.

# Purpose
This C file implements sysvar account handling for the execution runtime. The [`fd_sysvar_account_update`](<#fd_sysvar_account_update>) function updates a sysvar account in the bank and account database. It reads the rent rules from `fd_bank_rent_query`, computes the rent-exempt minimum balance, loads the account record, saves the previous account hash state, and then writes the new account fields. It sets the account owner to `fd_sysvar_owner_id`, updates the slot, and replaces the account data. If the new rent-exempt balance requires more lamports than the account already has, it mints the difference and adds it to the bank capitalization. It then updates the account hash state and finalizes the mutable account record.

The file also defines [`fd_sysvar_instr_acct_check`](<#fd_sysvar_instr_acct_check>), which validates that an instruction account at a given index matches an expected public key. It checks that the index is in range and compares the transaction account key against the required address. This function returns execution error codes when the account list is too short or when the address does not match.
